Subject: Staff Farewell

It is with much regret I advise that Wilna Joubert, Team Leader Events
Management is leaving Massey for a new life in Australia.

We will be holding an afternoon tea for Wilna in the Study Centre Staff
Lounge, this Thursday (24th) at 3pm for those who wish to farewell
Wilna.  A card and donation envelope will be located in the Deputy
Vice-Chancellor's office.  Please RSVP to l.a.khdoralc@massey.ac.nz for
catering purposes.



Andrea Davies, BBS,MBA
Regional Registrar Auckland
Albany Campus
Massey University
Private Bag 102 904
North Shore Mail Centre
09 4140800 extn 9516 or 021 246 2258
